<action type="say">
If the site shows “No accounts to display,” it usually means the online profile you’re using doesn’t have any accounts linked to it (or the account is very new/closed).

A few quick checks you can do:
1. **Confirm login**: Are you sure this is the only username you’ve ever used with this bank? If you might have another login, try signing out and back in with the other one.
2. **New account?** If you just opened this checking account in the last 1–2 business days, it may not have finished linking to online banking yet.
3. **Previously saw it here?** Have you ever seen this checking account on this overview page before, or is this your first time checking online?

Because no accounts are showing at all (both to me and on the website), the next step is to have the bank link or fix your account on the back end. Do one of these:
- Use the site’s **“Message us” / “Secure message” / “Help”** option and say:  
  “My online banking overview shows ‘No accounts to display.’ I have a checking account that should be linked to this profile. Can you verify my profile and link my checking account?”
- Or call the bank’s customer service number on the back of your debit card and tell them the same thing.
- Or visit a branch and ask them to check that your checking account is correctly linked to your online banking ID.

Have this ready when you contact them:
- Your **full name**
- **Last 4 digits** of your checking account number (or debit card if that’s what you have)
- Your **online username** (if they ask)

If you tell me whether you prefer **calling**, **messaging through the site**, or **going to a branch**, I can give you a short script with exactly what to say. </action>
